notes.title: Patch Note ver.1.0.7
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK".

The following features were added and bugs were fixed in ver. 1.0.7.

[h3]◆New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Option to assign keyboard keys for "up, down, left, and right".
[*] Option to synchronize the screen display vertically.
[/list][h3]◆Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Input devices are not recognized when a pressure-sensitive keyboard is connected.
[*] Input devices are not recognized when a specific virtual gamepad is installed.
[*] Blurred text in full screen mode.
[*] The screen would remain dark when warping again immediately after warping.
[*] Other minor bugs
[/list]


If you notice any other problems, please report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1782150/discussions/0/3424439048260300625/]bug report thread[/url].

If you have anything that you need our support team's help, please contact us using the form below.
URL: https://kdq.jp/ovl-game-support

Thank you for your continued support of OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK.

notes.title: Patch Note ver.1.0.6
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK".

We have made the following adjustments and bug fixes.

[h3]◆Fixed the following bugs/issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Forced shutdown relating to memory release timing
[*] Clementine got pushed down to the ground when stands under the elevator.
[*] Some of warp doors could not be selected.
[*] Clementine could fall through a wall when taking damage while climbing a wall with Stride of Wind.
[*] Minimap display bug
[*] "Obtain all magic" achievement could not be unlocked.
*The achievement will automatically be unlocked when the saved data that fulfills the conditions is loaded in this version. 
[/list]


If you notice any other problems, please report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1782150/discussions/0/3424439048260300625/]bug report thread[/url].

If you have anything that you need our support team's help, please contact us using the form below.
URL: https://kdq.jp/ovl-game-support

Thank you for your continued support of OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK.

notes.title: Patch Note ver.1.0.4
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK".

We have made the following adjustments and bug fixes.

[h3]◆Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*]Controller buttons for select/cancel can now be swapped in the option menu.
[*]The contrast and interval of the white flash effect were adjusted.
[*]Adjusted the position of the save point.
[*]Other minor adjustments
[/list][h3]◆Bug fixes[/h3][list]
[*]Bugs that caused controllers and keyboards not be recognized.
[*]Bugs that Clementine gets stuck in the cage when she enters it with an enemy.
[*]Bugs that some of the cages with enemies are not lifted up.
[*]The mini-maps in the "Throne", "Dense Forest," and "Glacier" were not correctly displayed.
[*]Some typo in the scenario text.
[/list]


If you notice any other problems, please report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1782150/discussions/0/3424439048260300625/]bug report thread[/url].

If you have anything that you need our support team's help, please contact us using the form below.
URL: https://kdq.jp/ovl-game-support

Thank you for your continued support of OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK.

notes.title: Known bugs and issues(UPDATE)
notes.content:
[h2]Known issues as of June 16th[/h2]

Thank you for playing "OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK".
We would like to inform you of the following bugs and how to work it around.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We have received several reports about the controller support.

[list]
[h3][*][strike]Controllers are not recognized or cannot be operated[/strike][/h3]

[strike]When using a controller, make sure to connect it before starting the game.
If the connection is made after the game has started, the game may not operate properly.
We are currently working on a fix so that the game will work properly even if the controller connection is made after the game has started.[/strike]
(Fixed in ver. 1.0.2)
[/list]
[list]
[h3][*][strike]Confirm button being A and Cancel button being B[/strike][/h3]

[strike]The buttons are being assigned based on standard Japanese style.
We are currently working to fix it so that you can assign confirm and cancel buttons. Please give us few days.[/strike]
(Fixed in ver. 1.0.4)

The initial button/key assignments are as follows:

[strike]We are currently working to change the decision button assignment, so please be patient.[/strike]
The initial key assignments are as follows

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41656292/71605252faaec964dfeaecec3acdf8ebf89eaf17.png[/img]

This can be changed from the OPTION menu in the game.
[/list]

(Added on June 24, 2022)
(Update on June 30, 2022)
(Update on July 20, 2022)
[h3]Known issues as of June 24th[/h3]
[h2]◆Items to be investigated/addressed[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a case that the controller and keyboard do not respond depending on the environment. 
[*] [strike]The cage of the ogre is not raised in the glacier stage, and there is a place that cannot be explored again.[/strike] (*1)
[*] Improvement of image quality in full screen mode.
[*] Flickering on the game screen.
[*] [strike]Certain doors cannot be selected in fast travel.[/strike] (*2)
[*] [strike]When taking damage while Stride of Wind, the wall will fall through.[/strike] (*2)
[*] [strike]It is possible to enter a cage and not be able to get out.[/strike] (*1)
[*] [strike]The mini-map display has some misalignments or too many or too few pathways.[/strike] (*2)
[*] [strike]Contrast of white flashing lights is reduced.[/strike] (*1)
[*] [strike]Unnecessary images are placed.[/strike] (*1)
[*] Improved keyboard key assignments,[strike] decision/cancel replacement.[/strike] (*1)
[*] Other minor problems
[/list] (*1) Fixed in ver. 1.0.4
(*2) Fixed in ver. 1.0.6


If you notice any other problems, please report them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1782150/discussions/0/3424439048260300625/]bug report thread[/url].

If you have anything that you need our support team's help, please contact us using the form below.
URL: https://kdq.jp/ovl-game-support

Thank you for your continued support of OVERLORD: ESCAPE FROM NAZARICK.
